notes: P02 task DSN-X01_state_spec for DSN 2027 (Recoverable Safety Journals for Crash-Consistent AI-Mediated Health-State Mutations, RQ1). state_machine.py implements the recoverable outcome function over the 3-way durable state (committed clinical row, versioned decision receipt ledger, transactional outbox with partial-effect delivery receipts) with logical timestamps: evaluate_durability(write_intent, durable_state) -> DurabilityVerdict returns exactly one of COMMITTED/REJECTED/INDETERMINATE with a stable reason code (33-code registry) for every (intent, state) pair. Fail-closed invariants: durable success is NEVER inferred without a decision receipt bound to the committed clinical row (row without receipt -> ORPHAN_RECEIPT_NO_CLINICAL_ROW, INDETERMINATE), an HTTP response/ACK is never durable evidence, disagreeing channels are never coerced into a safe rejection, and an unexpected internal error yields INDETERMINATE/INTERNAL_EVALUATION_ERROR via a final guard instead of raising. Windows covered per CASE_MATRIX: DSN-CASE-01 nominal all-channels-agree -> COMMITTED (EFFECT_APPLIED); DSN-CASE-02 crash before WAL commit (all channels ABSENT) -> REJECTED NOT_COMMITTED_NO_DURABLE_EVIDENCE (no phantom success); DSN-CASE-03 crash after commit before ACK -> COMMITTED PENDING_DELIVERY (retry reconciles by immutable operation ID, unknown-response reconciliation); DSN-CASE-04 broker replay x3 identical effect digests -> COMMITTED DUPLICATE_DELIVERY_IDEMPOTENT with all deliveries recorded; DSN-CASE-05 consent revoked between authorization and commit (row stamped with post-revocation epoch) -> REJECTED FORBIDDEN_WRITE_POST_REVOCATION; DSN-CASE-06 corrupted signed receipt (stored transition digest != row digest) -> INDETERMINATE RECEIPT_DIGEST_MISMATCH (tamper flagged, never silent success); DSN-CASE-07 outbox delayed (no delivery yet) -> COMMITTED PENDING_DELIVERY (storage commit separated from downstream delivery); stale receipt (row_version behind committed row) -> INDETERMINATE STALE_RECEIPT_VERSION_MISMATCH; plus outbox fsync failure record -> REJECTED, torn clinical row / corrupt ledger / corrupt outbox -> INDETERMINATE, orphan ledger receipt without row -> INDETERMINATE (never a rejection licensing a duplicate effect), orphan outbox without row -> INDETERMINATE, divergent duplicate effect digests -> INDETERMINATE DUPLICATE_EFFECT_DIVERGENCE, delivery/commit/receipt timestamp anomalies -> INDETERMINATE, receipt decision conflict -> REJECTED, epoch-from-future -> INDETERMINATE, cross-channel operation mismatch -> INDETERMINATE, malformed intent/state (incl. ABSENT-carrying-payload) -> INDETERMINATE. recover(history: EventHistory) -> RecoveryVerdict folds ordered crash episodes (WRITE_INTENT/CRASH/DURABLE_STATE/DELIVER/EVALUATION events over 4 crash points mirroring CASE_MATRIX): replays at-least-once DELIVER events into the outbox channel, preserves recorded evaluations, and fails closed on incomplete histories (no intent/state), unknown event kinds, unknown crash points, malformed events and conflicting intents (HISTORY_INCOMPLETE / UNKNOWN_HISTORY_EVENT / MALFORMED_HISTORY_EVENT / STATE_OPERATION_MISMATCH). Pure functions: logical timestamps only, no clock/randomness/I/O/provider; typed dataclasses are JSON-serializable with to_dict/from_dict round-trips verified; retries keyed by stable operation ID are idempotent (identical verdict digests). Tests: 48 passed (14 positive incl. determinism/idempotence/round-trip/registry, 34 adversarial+history incl. all four required crash windows, duplicate delivery, stale receipt, tamper, governance race, fail-closed fold). Shared evaluation suite regression: 679 passed. uvx ruff@0.7.1 check clean. source_sha_after records the base commit 06125d52 per sibling convention (DSN-dataset); the single task commit SHA is created immediately after this report and recorded in the commit body. Oracle independence preserved: the test module imports only the module under test; no candidate runtime, DB, model or live provider involved.
